course_name_original: Ensayo y Verificación de Equipos Electrónicos
course_name_en: Testing and Verification of Electronic Equipment
prerequisites: It is advisable that the student has successfully passed the electronics courses from previous years.

learning_outcomes.text: Know and use complex laboratory instrumentation for the measurement and quantification of EMI.
Interpret and execute measurement protocols appropriately for each situation, both those established in standards and those proposed by manufacturers.
Understand EMI related standards and choose the appropriate test for each application, in accordance with them.
Know different strategies for EMI reduction, such as shielding, PCB design, etc., which lead to passing the tests established in the standards.

syllabus_topics: Regulations, tests and equipment for EMC
Practical examples of tests and applicable regulations
Implications of EMI on people's safety and health

assessment_methods.method: Individual work (PCB design with EMC criteria)

assessment_rules: The final grade for the written exam and the individual work must each be equal to or greater than 5 out of 10 for the student to pass the course. The grades obtained are retained exclusively for the calls of the same academic year.
